title: Plan class: bugfix (shared acceptance invariants)
description: The CLASS rubric bugfix plans' acceptance rubrics reference (acceptance-rubrics-on-every-plan-2026-08-11 D-006): a fix is done when the ROOT CAUSE is removed and guarded, not when the symptom stops. Graded at plan completion by a NON-implementer.

criteria.title: Root cause identified where it ORIGINATES
criteria.model: The defect's cause is named at its origin, not where it surfaced — 'resolved' without a named root cause is a mitigation wearing a fix's label.
criteria.method: Read the plan/work-item record: does it name the originating mechanism, with the evidence that pinned it (not a plausible narrative)?
criteria.driftMarkers: Fix described only at the symptom site; 'high load' or 'transient' offered as the cause without a mechanism.

criteria.title: A guard fails if the CLASS returns
criteria.model: A test/assert/health-check exists that goes red if this class of defect recurs — every fix leaves the system harder to break the same way.
criteria.method: Name the guard (test file / lint / invariant); confirm it FAILS against the pre-fix behavior (falsifiability — a control mutant or the recorded red run).
criteria.driftMarkers: Fix with no guard; a guard that has never been shown able to fail; the detector that missed the bug left unexamined.

criteria.title: The failing case now passes, verified for real
criteria.model: The original failing scenario was re-run against the fixed system and passes — verification is observed, not inferred from the diff.
criteria.method: Reproduce the original failure input/state; run it post-fix (test run, live probe); the record shows the output.
criteria.driftMarkers: 'Fixed' claimed from code reading; verification deferred to 'see how it fares'.

criteria.title: Stopgaps labeled; durable fix landed or tracked
criteria.model: Restart-to-clear, retry-around, widen-a-timeout, catch-and-swallow, and disable-the-feature are mitigations; any shipped stopgap is labeled TEMPORARY MITIGATION with a filed+owned durable fix.
criteria.method: Read the change: is anything in it a mitigation presented as the fix? If a stopgap shipped, find its tracking item and owner.
criteria.driftMarkers: A band-aid closing the item; the durable fix living only in prose that scrolls away.

criteria.title: The independent grader audits the audit
criteria.model: The independent grader opens a sample of the implementer's plan-audit citations and confirms each sampled code/test reference resolves against the current tree and actually supports the audited item — the audit verdict itself is never accepted as proof.
criteria.method: Read the subject plan's effective per-item audit. Spot-check at least one resolving code/test citation (and expand the sample after any mismatch): open the cited current blob, compare it with the item requirement and audit claim, and record what was checked. Treat doc, workitem, and none citations as declarations of non-verification, never substitutes for code truth.
criteria.driftMarkers: A grade copied from the audit's PASS label; no cited blob opened; a stale blob hash ignored; doc/work-item prose treated as proof that code exists.
